sections.title: Event Opening
sections.avatar_script: Good morning everyone, and welcome to our Internal Innovation Showcase! I'm Nova, your co-host for today. Over the next few hours, we'll be showcasing some incredible projects from our teams. Get ready to be inspired!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: Main host stands by. Background music fades.

sections.title: Category 1 Introduction — AI & Machine Learning
sections.avatar_script: Let's start with our first category: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our teams have been working hard to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. Let's see what they've built!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: Category title slide appears. First project team gets ready.

sections.title: Project 1 Introduction
sections.avatar_script: Our first project is from [Team Name]. They'll be presenting [Project Title]. This project focuses on [one-line description]. Please welcome [Presenter Name]!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: Customize [Team Name], [Project Title], [Presenter Name]. Presenter walks to stage.

sections.title: Project 1 Q&A Transition
sections.avatar_script: Thank you [Presenter Name]! That was fascinating. I've already got some questions from our audience. [Pause] Now, let's open it up for questions!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: LIVE MODE: Main host takes over for Q&A. Operator ready for unexpected questions.

sections.title: Project 2 Introduction
sections.avatar_script: Let's move on to our second project! [Team Name] is here to tell us about [Project Title]. This team has been working on [one-line description]. Let's give them a warm welcome!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: Same pattern as Project 1. Customize fields.

sections.title: Coffee Break
sections.avatar_script: We've seen some amazing work so far! Let's take a quick 15-minute coffee break. Grab a drink, network with your colleagues, and we'll be back shortly with more projects!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: Break slide with timer. Background music plays.

sections.title: Category 2 Introduction — Infrastructure & Platforms
sections.avatar_script: Welcome back! Now let's dive into our second category: Infrastructure and Platforms. These are the foundations that make everything else possible. Let's see what our platform teams have been building!
sections.speaker: avatar

sections.title: Category 2 - Project 1
sections.avatar_script: Our next project comes from [Team Name]. They've built [Project Title] — [one-line description]. Please welcome [Presenter Name] to the stage!
sections.speaker: avatar

sections.title: Panel Discussion
sections.avatar_script: Now it's time for something a little different. We have a special panel discussion lined up! Our panelists will be discussing [Panel Topic]. Let's bring them all on stage!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: LIVE MODE: Panel discussion. Main host moderates. Operator ready.

sections.title: Voting Reminder
sections.avatar_script: Before we wrap up, don't forget to cast your votes! You can vote for your favorite project using [voting method]. Voting closes at [closing time].
sections.speaker: avatar

sections.title: Event Closing
sections.avatar_script: And that's a wrap! We've seen [number] incredible projects from our talented teams. Thank you to all our presenters, and thank you all for being here today. The innovation in this room is truly inspiring. Keep building, keep creating, and I'll see you at the next showcase. Goodbye everyone!
sections.speaker: avatar
sections.notes: Applause. Closing credits slide. Main host says final thanks.
